description: Multilingual trivia MCP — 1.4M+ blended, deduped questions from 11 open datasets (CC, MIT), English and Polish at launch. Calibrated 5-level difficulty (trivial → expert), cultural-affinity regions, per-record attribution (source, author, license). 12 tools, 4 prompts, 3 resources. OAuth 2.1 + Bearer API key. Free tier 500 req/day, no credit card.

findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.
